title: 363 - Kickle Cubicle
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.name: Kickle Cubicle
items.description: The episode's game: a top-down puzzle game where an ice-breathing hero slides frozen enemies into water to build paths.

items.name: Adventures of Lolo
items.description: The earlier top-down puzzle game the hosts compare Kickle Cubicle to, and an Essential Games List entry.

items.name: Super Mario Bros.
items.description: Used as an example of a hero who just happens to be very good at jumping.

items.name: The Witness
items.description: Open-world puzzle game used as a measure of hard puzzle difficulty.

items.name: Spelunky
items.description: Its ghost that chases slow players is compared to the game's timer enemy.

items.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
items.description: Cited alongside Mario as games where the character just dies when the timer runs out.

items.name: Bowser
items.description: Mario's enemy, joked about in a riff on why timers kill the hero.

items.name: Ratchet & Clank
items.description: PlayStation series whose first game's twist involving Captain Qwark is spoiled.

items.name: Call of Duty
items.description: Compared to Kickle Cubicle's short story mode with the real play in the challenge levels.

items.name: NEStalgia Essential Games List
items.description: The show's running vote on which NES games are essential.

items.name: Little Nemo: The Dream Master
items.description: Next week's game, based on a film that was made by an American and a Japanese studio.

links.label: Wikipedia: Little Nemo: The Dream Master

items.name: Little Nemo: Adventures in Slumberland
items.description: The 1992 film made by American and Japanese studios that the Capcom game is based on.

links.label: Wikipedia: Little Nemo: Adventures in Slumberland

items.name: Little Nemo
items.description: The early 20th-century comic strip the film and game ultimately come from.
